subject: Air freight quote to MEL
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote your cheapest air freight option to MEL (Melbourne, AU) for printed marketing material? The cargo will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-28 at our site in 72128 (Tuebingen), Germany. Please arrange the truck from our site to the airport and include this in your quote.

Lot 1: 1 drum, together 130 kg gross (114 kg net), together 0.70 cbm
Lot 2: 3 cartons, each 23 kg gross (20 kg net), each 60 x 40 x 126 cm
Lot 3: 8 crates, each 28 kg gross (24 kg net), each 60 x 40 x 15 cm

Please send all lots together as a single consignment under one air waybill and quote one all-in price in EUR for the complete shipment.

Thank you.

Best greetings from Regensburg
Tobias Auer
Versand / Shipping
Auer Maschinenbau GmbH

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting an all-in quote for a new air-freight shipment to Melbourne.
